findings: The NIKL guide treats **-(으)면 안 되다** as a prohibition expression; it gives the politeness-level form **안 돼요** in classroom permission/prohibition contexts and contrasts a prohibited action with the permission construction **-어도 되다**. This entry is limited to that use.
